Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def max_fixed_window_sum(values, k):
    if k <= 0 or k > len(values): raise ValueError("invalid window size")
    current = sum(values[:k]); best = current
    for right in range(k, len(values)):
        current += values[right] - values[right-k]
        best = max(best, current)
    return best

assert max_fixed_window_sum([2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2], 3) == 9
```
explanation: Update the current window by subtracting the leaving item and adding the incoming one. O(n) time, O(1) auxiliary space.
